verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows Vapi exposing its own APIs as an MCP *server* for external AI assistants (e.g., Claude Desktop) to manage calls/assistants — the reverse direction of the story. There is no documentation or probe showing a Vapi voice assistant can itself act as an MCP *client*, plugging in external MCP servers as tool sources mid-call; tool integration is instead described only via webhook-based custom tools and OpenAI-style function calling.
